title: The newsletter sign-up — content/newsletter.json
description: Where the sign-up form sends an address. While `action` is empty, no form prints anywhere and readers are pointed at the RSS feed instead.

provider.description: The service that holds subscribers' addresses, by name: "Buttondown". The colophon tells readers who holds their email; it is required once `action` is set.

action.description: The address the form posts to, from your service's embed instructions. Buttondown: https://buttondown.com/<your-username>/embed-subscribe. Leave empty to show no form.

field.description: The name the service expects for the email box. "email" for Buttondown and most others.

pitch.description: One line above the box. Promise only what you will do: no cadence you are not keeping.
